name: bflow
description: Autonomous SDLC workflow orchestration platform and CLI (bflow).

scripts.lint: pnpm run check:deps && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm exec tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm run build && vitest run && pnpm --filter @bflow/web test
scripts.test:fast: pnpm run build && vitest run --config vitest.fast.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && vitest run --config tests/e2e/vitest.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run check:deps && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
